name: tree_bare
description: Tutorial outdoors bare tree, straight down: thick forked limbs with tip lace and moss. Tall: trunk_base (ground contact) + canopy_top (height-shifted crown).
scale_note: Brief B size 4 x 4 units = 320 x 320 art px. Collision in tree.tscn is 22 x 14 world px (55 x 35 art). The canopy covers the larger crown; the trunk_base covers the ground contact. Pivot is the canvas centre.
